title: Runtime and importability
requirements: 01.01. The file targets the requested Python runtime.
01.02. Python 3.12 is used as the stable syntax baseline, with supplied Python 3.13–3.15 rules applied where relevant.
01.03. The file begins with `from __future__ import annotations`.
01.04. The file uses only valid demonstrated or known language syntax and standard-library APIs.
01.05. Every name evaluated during module import, decorator evaluation, base-class evaluation, and class definition is imported or defined.
01.06. Imports under `TYPE_CHECKING` are required only for annotations and are not needed by runtime operations.
01.08. The file can parse and import successfully under the requested Python version.
